verdict.rationale: Navan's MCP and Ava AI let users query policy and flagged/violating transactions conversationally (e.g., 'what's our policy on rideshare and which transactions violate it', 'analyze spend vs policy'), which covers the 'explaining declines/policy' angle in a retrospective, query-driven way. However there is no evidence of proactive receipt-chasing, real-time decline explanations, or a pre-spend 'can I expense this?' conversational check before the purchase occurs — the examples shown are all post-hoc analysis/reporting rather than in-the-moment policy enforcement. Missing for 10: proactive missing-receipt nudges, real-time decline explanation flow, and pre-purchase expense eligibility checks.
